EWSF.description: Effective Width Scale Factor (EWSF). Keyed by element number; ITEMS is a list of scale-factor definitions, one per boundary group, applied to the section's effective width. Each item carries the I-End (Sby/z_top/z_bot) factors, and when bJ is true also the J-End factors.

ITEMS.description: List of effective width scale factor definitions for the element. Each entry sets the I-End factors and optionally the J-End factors (used only when bJ is true).

ID.description: Serial number of the item within the element key. Distinguishes multiple scale-factor definitions.

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary group name this scale factor applies to. Empty string means no group (group key 0). If non-empty it must match an existing boundary group name, otherwise the request is rejected.

LYSCALE.description: I-End ly scale factor for Sby (effective width scale factor).

bJ.description: J-End check box. When true, the J-End scale factors (LYSCALE_J, ZTSCALE_J, ZBSCALE_J) are applied; when false they are ignored.

LYSCALE_J.description: [bJ=true] J-End ly scale factor for Sby. Used only when bJ is true.

ZTSCALE_J.description: [bJ=true] J-End z_top scale factor. Used only when bJ is true.

ZBSCALE_J.description: [bJ=true] J-End z_bot scale factor. Used only when bJ is true.
